name: Tom nuong moi
summary: Grilled shrimp on the Thới Sơn orchard table, served beside the fried elephant-ear fish and the islet’s other plates.
howToEat: Order it with the other islet plates at the midday orchard stop.
where: The orchard stops on cù lao Thới Sơn, about 6 km from Mỹ Tho by boat.
seoTitle: Tom nuong moi on Thoi Son
seoDescription: Tôm nướng mọi, grilled shrimp on the Thới Sơn orchard table beside the fried elephant-ear fish.
